_note: DIVA EXPRESSION <- the MMD morph weights that arm that face.  Each rule is a CONDITION on the dance's morph weights, not a blend to match: a face is worn while its condition holds.  The table is data - edit it and the exporter follows.

_how_it_works.all: every rule is `all`: a list of requirements and ALL of them must hold.  A requirement is {"morph": name, "min": X} (weight >= X), {"morph": name, "gt": X} (weight > X), or {"any": [ ...requirements... ]} where one of them is enough.
_how_it_works.not_zero: `gt: 0` means "not zero".  It is read as `weight > 0 + epsilon`, so an interpolation tail or a rounding crumb cannot arm a face; set `epsilon` to 0 to make it literal.
_how_it_works.winner: `tier` is the priority and it comes first: while any face in a higher tier is satisfied, no lower tier can take over.  1 is the highest.  Within one tier: highest `priority`, then the largest sum of thresholds, then the most requirements, then the earlier rule in this file.
_how_it_works.release: when nothing is satisfied, the next `bridge_s` seconds are checked first: if another face arms within them, the outgoing face is held across the gap so the dance goes A -> B instead of A -> rest -> B.  A longer silence writes EXPRESSION(chara, 21, 100, 0), the clear face measured at idx 21.
_how_it_works.min_hold_s: a winner must stay the winner this long before a cue is written, so a two-frame wobble does not become two cues.
_how_it_works.confidence: `probe` = watched in game through the expression probe; `guess` = inferred, needs a probe run first.  Nothing is emitted from a rule below `min_confidence`.

_source: In-game probe of PV 8331 (mod AAA).  The id numbering was confirmed at the same time: EXP_SLOTS[i] matched the observed face for 21 of 21 readable indices 0..22.  The conditions and the tiers below are the ones the user wrote out.

_tiers.1: eyelid: the winks and the shut eye
_tiers.2: a named expression with its own second condition (eyelid or anger level)
_tiers.4: the eyelid at a low weight only

_open_items: idx 4, 6 and 23..41 were never observed, so they have no rule.

`MIK_FACE_CLARIFYING` (まばたき >= 0.1) and `MIK_FACE_GENTLE` (まばたき >= 0.2) are tier 4 and are armed by the eyelid morph, which blinks constantly - they will fire on ordinary blinking whenever nothing higher is satisfied.
idx 2, 15 and 20 are `guess` and are not emitted.
